label: Objective probability law: determination, law fork and realization at the will step
summary: Delivers the #2145 Probability-law slice (issue comment 2026-11-27 09:06) in TruthCore.Explanation.ObjectiveProbability, stacked on #2144's shared BinaryLaw module. Formalized: unique_invariant_of_transitive (one orbit fixes the uniform law; two orbits on Bool x Bool leave the orbit mass free, a continuum of invariant full-support laws); stationary_binary_iff (stationary iff x(a+b)=b in real masses; unique for a+b>0 with an explicit stationary law, every law for a+b=0; identity, reset and flip controls; uniqueness is not convergence: the flip orbit of a point mass alternates and never reaches the unique stationary law); mixture_preserves_invariance, binary_mixture_injective, the bind_const collapse and the worked 3/4, 1/4 mixture (lower mass 1/4 + t/2); law_fork as a general value fork on PSRStrength.Arena (constant across accessible worlds, hence not contingent, or varying and explained), applied symmetrically: if the operating law is a selector's adopted law and varies, both the law fact and the adoption fact need admitted reasons; matched controls (same record and credence, different law; admitted base reason does not fix the law); realization_independent_of_support on #462's varying profile versus the same profile with causal edges removed (a structural independence control, not a countermodel to an actual intrinsically productive disposition); a STIT model in which seeing to a law's adoption sees to neither its sample nor the contrary, and the general STIT lemma (Dstit on the law plus a contrary cell-mate gives no Cstit on the effect; no plan vocabulary). Review repair (2026-11-28): kernel relocation stated; connection plan to 66aecdd7 now requires contingency (existing premise fbd0a6d3) AND only-intentional admissibility; the realization test retargeted from 4be0f774 to 2f9a99cc (argument 9203e79c); LawProfile field propensity renamed law. Removed from the earlier draft: RealizationRoute (returned its own hypothesis with the existing necessaryRootAncestor: a projection, effectively a transcription), ProductiveControl (replaced by the slice's varying/emptied control), FixedBy/RepresentsLaw/operative (replaced by TracksValue/FixesValue). Deferred: general finite-kernel existence and irreducible uniqueness, infinite chains, topological convergence, the 1/12-grid arithmetic diagnostic (superseded by the general binary theorems); fixed ranking and no universal net selection are reused from PSRLaterAxes.probability, not re-proved. Provisional comparison: a necessary intrinsic law passes the contingent-fact PSR's constant branch; one symmetry orbit fixes only the uniform law, and a stationary law is fixed only relative to a kernel that is itself a quantitative law, so a non-uniform law needs quantitative input (relocation, not determination), and the open questions are whether that input is grounded in the source and whether the law is productively realized; a contingent brute law conflicts with the contingent-fact PSR (not logically inconsistent apart from it); a higher-order mixture helps only if its upper law is warranted and operative; personal selection can settle content for reasons without necessitating effects but faces the same demand for any contingent adoption. No demonstrated defeat of the impersonal account and no premise discharged. Lean build, binding and Comparator/NanoDa pass locally; independent semantic review pending.
blocker: Open interfaces: productive calibration of a law to the actual same root; warrant for the contingent-fact PSR's coverage of the law fact; explanation of the particular outcome beyond comparative probabilities; positive actual rational apprehension and exercise (#2145 beede613/4be0f774, same witness 29818edd/66aecdd7). Next test: a premise identifying the admitted reason for a contingent law or content fact at the root with intentional exercise, assessed against a necessary intrinsic law with a structurally unique form.

current_assessment.scope: The #2145 probability-law slice as delivered in PR #2151: determination controls, the symmetric law fork and the realization/sample controls.
current_assessment.assessment: Structure fixes a probability law only in limited ways: one symmetry orbit gives only the uniform law, and stationarity relocates the law question to a kernel that is itself a quantitative law. The contingent-fact PSR demands a reason for a varying law and equally for a varying adoption; an admitted reason need not fix the law or be intentional. Support matching does not establish realization, and seeing to a law's adoption does not see to its sample. No defeat of the impersonal account; no premise discharged.
current_assessment.next_test: Find or formulate premise (b) of the 66aecdd7 connection plan (only intentional exercise is admissible as a reason for a contingent law or content fact at the root) and test it against a necessary intrinsic law with quantitative input grounded in the source.
current_assessment.evidence: Independent semantic review of PR #2151 at 95104a53b (2026-11-28): two P1s (kernel relocation overstated as determination without an agent; mislabelled and insufficient contingency option in the 66aecdd7 connection plan) and four P2s (4be0f774 is not the plan-to-outcome step; DNP_inv test wording; two slice items missing from Deferred; LawProfile field named propensity). All repaired in the following commit (both missing slice items proved); the repair is not re-reviewed.
